name: Methylenedioxyhydroxyethylamphetamine
summary: MDHOET, also known as 3,4-methylenedioxy-N-hydroxyethylamphetamine or as N-hydroxyethyl-MDA, is a lesser-known drug and a substituted amphetamine. It is also the N-hydroxyethyl analogue of MDA.

fact.en: It is MDA with a hydroxyethyl group on its nitrogen, one of a long run of N-substituted MDA relatives that Alexander Shulgin described in PiHKAL.
fact.zh: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接羥乙基，屬於亞歷山大．舒爾金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一長串 N-取代 MDA 親戚之一。
fact.zhHans: 它就是在 MDA 的氮原子上接羟乙基，属于亚历山大．舒尔金在《PiHKAL》中描述的一长串 N-取代 MDA 亲戚之一。
